words.definition: The process of intervening in a conflict to help the parties resolve their differences
words.definationTranslation: Ek vivad mein dalal banana aur pakshon ko unke antar ko suljhane mein madad karna

sentence.sentence: The mediator helped the two countries to reach a peace agreement through mediation.
sentence.translation: Madhyasth ne do deshon ko mediation ke madhyam se shanti samjhauta tak pahunchane mein madad ki.

sentence.sentence: Mediation is often used to resolve labor disputes.
sentence.translation: Mazdoor vivadon ko suljhane ke liye aksar madhyasthata ka upyog kiya jata hai.

words.definition: The process of resolving a dispute by submitting it to a neutral third party for a decision
words.definationTranslation: Ek vivad ko suljhane ka prakriya, jismein use tisri paksh ke samaksh nirdesh ke liye prastut kiya jata hai

sentence.sentence: The company agreed to arbitration to settle the dispute with its employees.
sentence.translation: Company ne apne kar्मचारion ke saath vivad ko suljhane ke liye madhyasthata ka nirdesh svikar kiya.

sentence.sentence: Arbitration can be a cost-effective way to resolve conflicts.
sentence.translation: Madhyasthata ka nirdesh vivadon ko suljhane ka laagat-prabhavi tareeka ho sakta hai.

words.definition: A person authorized to act on behalf of another person or organization
words.definationTranslation: Ek vyakti jo doosre vyakti ya sangathan ke paksh mein kaam karne ke liye adhikrit hota hai

sentence.sentence: The company sent a delegate to the conference to represent their interests.
sentence.translation: Company ne apne hiton ko pratinidhitv karne ke liye ek pratinidhi ko sammelan mein bheja.

sentence.sentence: The delegate was authorized to make decisions on behalf of the organization.
sentence.translation: Pratinidhi ko sangathan ke paksh mein nirnay lene ke liye adhikrit kiya gaya tha.

words.definition: A person authorized to act on behalf of another person or organization, especially in a voting situation
words.definationTranslation: Ek vyakti jo doosre vyakti ya sangathan ke paksh mein kaam karne ke liye adhikrit hota hai, visheshkar voting ki sthiti mein

sentence.sentence: The shareholder gave a proxy to his attorney to vote on his behalf.
sentence.translation: Shareholder ne apne vakil ko apne paksh mein voting karne ke liye pratinidhi di.

sentence.sentence: The proxy holder exercised the proxy and voted for the proposed resolution.
sentence.translation: Pratinidhi dharkar ne pratinidhi ka upyog kiya aur prastavith samadhan ke liye vote kiya.

words.definition: A person who acts on behalf of another person or organization
words.definationTranslation: Ek vyakti jo doosre vyakti ya sangathan ke paksh mein kaam karta hai

sentence.sentence: The agent negotiated the contract on behalf of the company.
sentence.translation: Karyakarta ne company ke paksh mein samjhauta kiya.

sentence.sentence: The agent was responsible for marketing the product and generating sales.
sentence.translation: Karyakarta utpad ke marketing aur bikri utpann karne ke liye jimmedar tha.

words.definition: The act of representing or speaking on behalf of someone or something
words.definationTranslation: Kisi vyakti ya vastu ke paksh mein pratinidhitva ya bolne ka kaam

sentence.sentence: The union provided representation for the workers in the negotiation.
sentence.translation: Mazdoor sangh ne vivad mein mazdooron ke liye pratinidhitva pradaan kiya.

sentence.sentence: The lawyer provided effective representation for the defendant in court.
sentence.translation: Vakil ne adalat mein abhigoptya ke liye prabhavi pratinidhitva pradaan kiya.

words.definition: A serious disagreement or argument between two or more people, groups, or organizations
words.definationTranslation: Do ya adhik vyaktiyon, samuhon ya sangathanon ke beech gahri asahmati ya tarak

sentence.sentence: The conflict between the two countries has been ongoing for years.
sentence.translation: Do deshon ke beech sangharsh kayi varshon se chal raha hai.

sentence.sentence: The conflict resolution team helped to resolve the dispute between the employees.
sentence.translation: Sangharsh samadhan team ne kar्मचariyon ke beech vivad ko suljhane mein madad ki.

words.definition: A disagreement or argument between two or more people, groups, or organizations
words.definationTranslation: Do ya adhik vyaktiyon, samuhon ya sangathanon ke beech asahmati ya tarak

sentence.sentence: The dispute between the company and its employees lasted for several months.
sentence.translation: Company aur uske kar्मचariyon ke beech vivad kayi mahino tak chala.

sentence.sentence: The government intervened in the dispute between the two countries to prevent a war.
sentence.translation: Sarkar ne do deshon ke beech vivad mein dakhil hokar yudh ko rokne mein madad ki.

words.definition: The process of discussing and reaching an agreement between two or more people, groups, or organizations
words.definationTranslation: Do ya adhik vyaktiyon, samuhon ya sangathanon ke beech samjhauta ki prakriya

sentence.sentence: The negotiation between the two countries resulted in a peace agreement.
sentence.translation: Do deshon ke beech samjhauta shanti samjhauta mein samapt hua.

sentence.sentence: The employer and the union were engaged in a difficult negotiation over wages and benefits.
sentence.translation: Niyokta aur mazdoor sangh vetan aur labhon par kathin samjhauta mein lage hue the.

words.definition: A person who is appointed to make a decision in a dispute or controversy
words.definationTranslation: Ek vyakti jo vivad ya vivad mein nirnay lene ke liye niyukt hota hai

sentence.sentence: The arbitrator made a decision in the dispute between the two companies.
sentence.translation: Madhyasthak ne do companyon ke beech vivad mein nirnay liya.

sentence.sentence: The government appointed an arbitrator to resolve the labor dispute.
sentence.translation: Sarkar ne mazdoor vivad ko suljhane ke liye ek madhyasthak niyukt kiya.

words.definition: A person who helps to resolve a dispute or conflict between two or more people, groups, or organizations
words.definationTranslation: Ek vyakti jo do ya adhik vyaktiyon, samuhon ya sangathanon ke beech vivad ya sangharsh ko suljhane mein madad karta hai

sentence.sentence: The mediator helped to resolve the conflict between the two countries.
sentence.translation: Madhyastha ne do deshon ke beech sangharsh ko suljhane mein madad ki.

sentence.sentence: The mediator facilitated a discussion between the employer and the union to resolve the dispute.
sentence.translation: Madhyastha ne vivad ko suljhane ke liye niyokta aur mazdoor sangh ke beech charcha ko samarthit kiya.

words.definition: A person who helps to make a process or activity easier or more efficient
words.definationTranslation: Ek vyakti jo kisi prakriya ya gatividhi ko aasan ya adhik kushal banane mein madad karta hai

sentence.sentence: The facilitator helped to make the meeting more productive.
sentence.translation: Sahayak ne baithak ko adhik utpadak banane mein madad ki.

sentence.sentence: The facilitator helped to resolve the conflict by providing a neutral perspective.
sentence.translation: Sahayak ne tattarasth drishtikon pradan karke sangharsh ko suljhane mein madad ki.

words.definition: Not taking sides or having a bias in a dispute or conflict
words.definationTranslation: Vivad ya sangharsh mein kisi paksh ka saath na dena ya kisi tarah ka pakshpaat na hona

sentence.sentence: The neutral arbitrator made a fair decision in the dispute.
sentence.translation: Tattarasth madhyasthak ne vivad mein nyayik nirnay liya.

sentence.sentence: The neutral mediator helped to resolve the conflict between the two countries.
sentence.translation: Tattarasth madhyastha ne do deshon ke beech sangharsh ko suljhane mein madad ki.

words.definition: Not biased or prejudiced in a dispute or conflict
words.definationTranslation: Vivad ya sangharsh mein nirapeksh ya pakshpaat na hona

sentence.sentence: The impartial arbitrator made a fair decision in the dispute.
sentence.translation: Nirapeksh madhyasthak ne vivad mein nyayik nirnay liya.

sentence.sentence: The impartial mediator helped to resolve the conflict between the two countries.
sentence.translation: Nirapeksh madhyastha ne do deshon ke beech sangharsh ko suljhane mein madad ki.

words.definition: An agreement or understanding between two or more people, groups, or organizations
words.definationTranslation: Do ya adhik vyaktiyon, samuhon ya sangathanon ke beech ek samjhauta ya samajh

sentence.sentence: The two countries reached an accord on trade.
sentence.translation: Do deshon ne vyapar par samjhauta kiya.

sentence.sentence: The employer and the union reached an accord on wages and benefits.
sentence.translation: Niyokta aur mazdoor sangh ne vetan aur labhon par samjhauta kiya.

words.definition: The act of resolving a dispute or conflict by reaching an agreement
words.definationTranslation: Ek samjhauta kiya jaane par vivad ya sangharsh ko suljhane ka kaam

sentence.sentence: The settlement of the dispute between the two companies was reached after months of negotiation.
sentence.translation: Do companyon ke beech vivad ka sthapana kayi mahino ki samjhauta ke baad hua.

sentence.sentence: The settlement of the conflict between the two countries was a major achievement.
sentence.translation: Do deshon ke beech sangharsh ka sthapana ek bada safalta thi.

words.definition: An agreement or settlement reached by making concessions or sacrifices
words.definationTranslation: Ruchiyaan ya balidaan dekar pahunchi gayi ek samjhauta ya sthapana

sentence.sentence: The compromise between the two parties was reached after lengthy negotiations.
sentence.translation: Do pakshon ke beech samanjasya lambe samjhauta ke baad pahunchi gayi.

sentence.sentence: The compromise on the trade agreement was a difficult decision.
sentence.translation: Vyapar samjhauta par samanjasya ek kathin nirnay tha.

words.definition: A mutual understanding or arrangement between two or more people, groups, or organizations
words.definationTranslation: Do ya adhik vyaktiyon, samuhon ya sangathanon ke beech ek paraspar samjhauta ya vyavastha

sentence.sentence: The two countries reached an agreement on trade.
sentence.translation: Do deshon ne vyapar par samjhauta kiya.

sentence.sentence: The employer and the union reached an agreement on wages and benefits.
sentence.translation: Niyokta aur mazdoor sangh ne vetan aur labhon par samjhauta kiya.

words.definition: A formal agreement or document that outlines the terms and conditions of a relationship or arrangement
words.definationTranslation: Ek aadhikarik samjhauta ya dastavez jo ek sambandh ya vyavastha ke sharten aur sharton ko nibhata hai

sentence.sentence: The contract between the two companies was signed after months of negotiation.
sentence.translation: Do companyon ke beech anubandh kayi mahino ki samjhauta ke baad par haihua.

sentence.sentence: The contract included provisions for the payment of wages and benefits.
sentence.translation: Anubandh mein vetan aur labhon ka bhugtan ke prabandh shamil the.

words.definition: A statement or provision in a document, such as a contract or agreement, that outlines a specific condition or requirement
words.definationTranslation: Ek dastavez, jaise anubandh ya samjhauta, mein ek aisi bayan ya prabandh jo ek vishisht sthiti ya aavashyakta ko nibhata hai

sentence.sentence: The contract included a clause that required the payment of a penalty for late delivery.
sentence.translation: Anubandh mein ek dhara shamil thi jo der se pahunchne par jurmана ka bhugtan aavashyak banati thi.

sentence.sentence: The agreement included a clause that prohibited the disclosure of confidential information.
sentence.translation: Samjhauta mein ek dhara shamil thi jo gopniya suchana ka prakat karne par pratibandh lagati thi.

words.definition: A condition or requirement that is specified in a document, such as a contract or agreement
words.definationTranslation: Ek dastavez, jaise anubandh ya samjhauta, mein nibhaya gaya ek sthiti ya aavashyakta

sentence.sentence: The contract included a stipulation that the work had to be completed within six months.
sentence.translation: Anubandh mein ek sharten shamil thi ki kaam ko chhe mahino ke andar pura karna hai.

sentence.sentence: The agreement included a stipulation that the payment had to be made within 30 days.
sentence.translation: Samjhauta mein ek sharten shamil thi ki bhugtan ko 30 dinon ke andar karna hai.

words.definition: A situation in which no progress can be made
words.definationTranslation: जिसमें कोई प्रगति नहीं की जा सकती

sentence.sentence: The negotiations reached an impasse and further discussions were postponed.
sentence.translation: वार्ता एक गतिरोध पर पहुंच गई और आगे की चर्चा स्थगित कर दी गई।

sentence.sentence: The company's inability to reach a decision led to an impasse in the project.
sentence.translation: कंपनी की निर्णय लेने में असमर्थता के कारण परियोजना में गतिरोध पैदा हो गया।

words.definition: The process of taking a dispute to a court of law
words.definationTranslation: विवाद को कानून के न्यायालय में ले जाने की प्रक्रिया

sentence.sentence: The company is facing litigation over the patent infringement.
sentence.translation: कंपनी पेटेंट उल्लंघन के लिए मुकदमेबाजी का सामना कर रही है।

sentence.sentence: The litigation process is often lengthy and expensive.
sentence.translation: मुकदमेबाजी की प्रक्रिया अक्सर लंबी और महंगी होती है।

words.definition: The power of a court to hear and decide a case
words.definationTranslation: मामले को सुनने और निर्णय लेने की अदालत की शक्ति

sentence.sentence: The court's jurisdiction is limited to cases involving federal laws.
sentence.translation: न्यायालय का अधिकार क्षेत्र सिर्फ संघीय कानूनों से संबंधित मामलों तक ही सीमित है।

sentence.sentence: The company is challenging the jurisdiction of the court to hear the case.
sentence.translation: कंपनी मामले की सुनवाई करने के लिए न्यायालय के अधिकार क्षेत्र को चुनौती दे रही है।

words.definition: The act of making a decision or judgment
words.definationTranslation: निर्णय या फैसला करने का कार्य

sentence.sentence: The adjudication process is designed to be fair and impartial.
sentence.translation: निर्णयन प्रक्रिया को निषपक्ष और निरपेक्ष होने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है।

sentence.sentence: The company is seeking adjudication to resolve the dispute.
sentence.translation: कंपनी विवाद का समाधान करने के लिए निर्णयन की मांग कर रही है।
